_what: C-9 T10-1e identity plates for outcrop_a, outcrop_b, heather_clump and dead_tree, cut from T10C-barrow_a with local masks (no fal cost).

outcrop_a.method: hand-traced outline (16 vertices, 20 px grid); vegetation and ice removed by hue inside it; CUT BY THE FRAME EDGE

outcrop_b.method: hand-traced outline (18 vertices, 20 px grid); vegetation and ice removed by hue inside it; CUT BY THE FRAME EDGE

heather_clump.method: warm-hue clump (h 12-50, s > 0.38), densest of the 0.55-0.95 m candidates; checked by eye (the classifier also finds fur)

dead_tree.method: evf-sam birch2_dead rank 1 (the snag), grown geodesically <= 16 px into desaturated grey wood to recover the thin limbs (+562 px)
